name: sombill-frontend
description: SomBill frontend workspace: apps/ (website + dashboards) and packages/ (shared code). The website is NOT a workspace member: it has its own React 19 / Tailwind 4 / Vite 8 dependency tree.

scripts.build: npm run build:website && npm run build:dashboards && node scripts/bundle-dist.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/website run lint && npm run typecheck:dashboards
